'''Cratzar''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Bastogard]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "No one knows whether Cratzar sold the gold or had it crafted into jewelry. But what's certain is Cratzar now carries an aura of power and nobility, like an underground king."

Cratzar is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.
